classification: Operational diagnostics, no strength inference or new feature experiment
controls: Same current research installation, accepted QXRAY and retained SEE OFF; four Search workers each
design: Existing sr024-worker-concurrency-cost.py: eight development roots, four rotated serial/concurrent repetitions, 300000 nodes per request, three one-million-node warmups per process
reasonForFour: First C4 clock block yielded 444.2 games/hour versus approximately 319 at C3, making asymmetric contention at four games materially relevant. Planned before examining fixed-node diagnostic results.
limitations: Homogeneous control groups, not mixed-policy clock games; limited roots and one host. Relative slowdown is a diagnostic, not proof of absent strength bias.
